items.title: INV-050/MECH-180 calibration-power-raised replication of the MEL third-drive coupling (repairs 861c's under-powered C2 near-miss)
items.note: CALIBRATION-POWER-RAISED replication of V3-EXQ-861c, per confirmed failure_autopsy_861c-861d-mech180-cluster_2026-08-16 (interactive gate, 2026-08-16, session cranky-driscoll-126a36). 861c's DV1/DV2 (sws_power, replay_rate) PASSED 3/3 seeds and both readiness gates PASSED at 1.0 -- the MEL consumer is functional. Only the decisive C2 leg failed (1/3 seeds), and the autopsy root-caused it EXACTLY: on_factor == mean_mel(ARM_3_HIGH_ON) / mel_reference, mel_reference estimated from CALIB_DRAWS=5 draws at rel_sd 0.152-0.283; at n=5 seed 271 misses the C2 margin by 0.5% purely on calibration sample size, while at n=10 (the autopsy's own confirmed projection) that margin flips to PASS. Seed 7 is DIFFERENT and genuine: its ARM_3_HIGH_ON mean MEL sits below its own no-shift stable base (the same link-(i) producer failure documented for 677/718/718a) -- more calibration draws cannot fix it. Governance verdict on 861c: non_contributory, status and v3_pending UNCHANGED (NOT a substrate ceiling -- 'a broken instrument is not evidence of a ceiling', autopsy Section 5). | THE FIX (autopsy Section 7 repair pathway, items 1-3): (1) CALIB_DRAWS 5 -> 10 (CALIB_EPISODES_PER_DRAW unchanged at 6; total calib episodes 30 -> 60; episodes_per_run 102 -> 132) -- the exact n the autopsy's own table shows flips seed 271's margin. (2) NEW pre-registered readiness precondition R3 (calibration_precision_adequate_on_decisive_arm): ARM_3_HIGH_ON's own mel_reference_calib_rel_sd_of_mean must not exceed MAX_CALIB_REL_SD_OF_MEAN=0.15 (pre-registered from the autopsy's n=10 projection of rel_sd/sqrt(10) in [0.048,0.090], ~67% headroom above the worst projected value) -- a seed whose calibration lands too imprecise to trust self-routes to substrate_not_ready_requeue rather than deciding C2 on an unreliable margin, closing the 'another under-powered near-miss' failure mode. (3) Seed 7's C2 failure is PRE-REGISTERED as a genuine, disjoint producer defect this run does NOT expect to fix -- SEED_PASS_FRAC=2/3 (unchanged) means a 2/3 C2 pass with seed 7 the lone miss is this run's target CONFIRMED outcome, not a partial result; do not read 2/3 as weaker than a hypothetical 3/3. | NOT IN SCOPE: V3-EXQ-861d's separate finding (MECH-122 relative_novelty clamp gate dead/saturated on 2/3 seeds, substrate_queue MECH122-CONTENT-PACKAGING-SPINDLE-SELECTION, severity corrupting, action=amend) is a different mechanism (USE_MECH122_SPINDLE_CONTENT_SELECTION=True) with its own separate repair, tracked independently -- this run keeps the flag OFF (861c/861b's value), same as 861c. | GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout (C2 under CALIB_DRAWS=10 + R3) exists in no recorded manifest -- 861c computed C2 at n=5 only and recorded no R3-equivalent; NOT recoverable -> run. | RE-DERIVE BRAKE (Step 2.5b): the confirmed cluster autopsy ITSELF already stamped re_derive_brake.fired=false on both its 861c and 861d targets ('Prior ceiling hits MECH-180=2, INV-050=3; this autopsy recommends standard, not substrate_ceiling, so neither count advances') -- this run inherits that confirmed, interactively-gated verdict directly (originally released at 861c-authoring-time on SD-MEL-PRODUCER being VALIDATED, V3-EXQ-798a). | SUBSTRATE OVERLAP (2.5c): two OPEN corrupting entries file-level-overlap (ree_core/agent.py, ree_core/sleep/mel_consumer.py are broadly imported) -- MECH122-CONTENT-PACKAGING-SPINDLE-SELECTION: EMPIRICALLY CONFIRMED inert for this run (agent.py's run_sws_schema_pass gates the entire consolidation_ref/relative_novelty() consumption behind use_mech122_spindle_content_selection, False in this run -- 'bit-identical to pre-MECH-122 behaviour' per the source comment); mode-governance-engagement: unrelated subsystem (salience_coordinator.py commitment/clamp), this driver never imports salience_coordinator.py or the regime_occupancy_gate pattern, only the near-universal REEConfig/REEAgent overlap. Three open DEGRADING entries noted, not blocking (SD-MECH267-CEM-SELECTION-FIX, SD-MECH303-THRESHOLD-SOURCING -- both arm-symmetric, same as 861c; SD-SLEEP-ENTRY-PRESSURE -- pending_implementation, driver never calls need_crossed). | claim_ids=[INV-050,MECH-180]: same tagging/direction logic as 861c, unchanged; does NOT clear MECH-180's v3_pending (DV3 still descoped). | Smoke PASS (dry-run: 3 cells [ARM_0/ARM_3/ARM_4], multi-draw calib n=2 exercised the mean+noise+R3 code paths, ep N/132 progress, 3 verdict lines, manifest carries calibration_redesign block incl. max_calib_rel_sd_of_mean + r3_frac, relocated out of evidence/). validate_experiments.py --strict OK, 0 warnings. validate_recording.py --strict OK, 0 always-core gaps. PROMOTES/DEMOTES NOTHING until /governance applies the verdict. | OPERATOR ACTION REQUIRED -- STEP 8.6 NOT PERFORMED: queued from ree-cloud-5 (headless metaworker box), which has no REE_assembly/coordinator.env, so POST /queue/add could not be issued. This entry is durably on origin/main (commit ab07bd30f1) but UNRUNNABLE by the fleet until a coordinator-capable box (the Mac) POSTs it from this commit.

items.title: MECH-489 (SD-099) valence-gating retest with decision counted at the override tick
items.note: DRIVER-SIDE instrument repair + the owed MECH-489 valence-gating retest, authored together because the retest is the thing that needs the corrected readout and the readout cannot be validated without a run (chip-20260820-mech489-retest-driver-decision-at-override-tick). SUBSTRATE half already landed 2026-08-20 (ree-v3 775eb55): the post-override decision window now expires unconditionally. THIS entry lands the DRIVER half. DEFECT: the 910-lineage _decision_alignment read the latched agent._orienting_decision once per ENV STEP while the persistence window is denominated in E3 TICKS; select_action returns the held action at agent.py:6546 BEFORE the Component 4/5 block at 8130, so on a non-E3 tick the orienting fields retain the previous tick's values. MEASURED this session (Step 2.5a probe, 40 env steps, seed 7, ON arm): agent._orienting_last_output read non-None on 40/40 env steps against only 4/40 genuine E3 ticks. CORRECTION TO THE PRIOR DIAGNOSIS, and it matters: orienting_override_fired is read off the SAME latched object, so the 910-lineage n_overrides was ITSELF replicated -- it was never a trustworthy denominator. The autopsy's 'set once, synchronously, in the same if _do_out.override_fired: block' is true of the SUBSTRATE VARIABLE and says nothing about a driver sampling the latched LOG FIELD per env step. So 910's 206/42 = 4.90 is a ratio of two inflated numbers (decision latched over the ~5-E3-tick window ~= 50 env steps; override latched over ~1 E3 tick ~= 10 env steps), and the true override count behind 910a's reported 21 is ~2 -- which also means 910a's MIN_OVERRIDES floor of 5 was ~10x weaker than it appeared. FIX: a NON-DESTRUCTIVE SENTINEL tap on REEAgent.select_action, the same idiom as experiments/_lib/fresh_select.py (699/689d instrument repair) -- stamp a private attribute on the current DefensiveOrientingOutput before the call; it is absent after the call iff the orienting block ran and replaced the object (tick() constructs a NEW output at all three return sites, defensive_orienting.py:220/233/330, never a cached one). On a FRESH tick with override_fired the driver increments n_override_ticks and classifies agent._orienting_decision synchronously in the same block -- the decision is counted AT THE OVERRIDE TICK ONLY, yielding exactly n_override_ticks classifications. n_latched_ticks / n_fresh_orienting_ticks are emitted alongside per /queue-experiment Step 3.5 'Sample-size integrity -- latched substrate diagnostics', so the true denominator is auditable rather than inferred from len(rows). Nulling the attribute would also have been safe (verified: its only other reader, the motor-arrest block at agent.py:9239, is inside the SAME select_action call downstream of the 8196 assignment -- no other def between 5839 and 9260 -- and the probe produced bit-identical action sequences with and without the clear); the sentinel is used anyway because it needs no such proof. The tap is armed ONLY around 906b's _observational_run, so its scope matches the per-step log's and the corrected and legacy counters are directly comparable. PRE-REGISTERED READINESS ASSERTION (machine-checked as load-bearing criterion C1): sum(decision_counts) == n_override_ticks EXACTLY, not ~e3_steps_per_tick times it. The legacy per-env-step readout is recomputed on the same run as diagnostics.legacy_per_env_step_readout with realized inflation ratios, so this run MEASURES the defect rather than inheriting its magnitude from the 910 aggregates. SCOPE: valence-gating sub-claim (Components 4/5) ONLY. Trigger-alignment (Components 1-3) already stands fairly falsified per failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-910_2026-08-10 and its 910a reconfirmation; its alignment/coupling numbers are still computed on the identical 906b substrate and reported for context (explicitly flagged as latched and NOT corrected, so they stay comparable to 910/910a) but are NOT pass criteria. CRITERIA: C1 above, plus C2 C_decision_alignment_non_degenerate (>=2 of the 3 decision classes non-zero -- 910's bug signature was 0 approach / 0 resume / 206 withdraw). AND over both; a vacuous pass on either forces FAIL. criteria_non_degenerate keys C1 to n_override_ticks > 0 (it would pass vacuously at 0 == 0) and C2 to the readiness floor. POWER: overrides are produced only in the observational eval, which is ~8% of a cell's steps (220 train eps x 200 steps vs the eval segments), so lengthening eval is far cheaper per additional override than adding seeds. EVAL_EPISODES raised 8 -> 48 by module-attribute swap on the reused 906b module, restored via try/finally (eval is ONE continuous multi-segment life per 906b's CONTINUITY REDESIGN, so this is a clean extension, not a semantic change), with 3 seeds. Expected ~19 genuine pooled overrides against a pre-registered floor of 10; below-floor self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue, which here would itself be the finding that SD-099 fires too rarely at its shipped defaults to measure its own decision. ARMS / DV SYMMETRY (Step 3 declaration, one per arm): orienting_on is the only SCORED arm; its DV is the class histogram of the resolved decision over override ticks, whose symmetry group is (i) permutation/relabelling of the three decision classes and (ii) any common monotone rescaling of the two z-scored channels -- the manipulation is NOT invariant under either, because with the gate off the DV has EMPTY SUPPORT (no override ticks exist at all), so enabling the gate changes the DV's domain, not merely its value. orienting_off is a STRUCTURAL NEGATIVE CONTROL: with use_defensive_orienting=False there is no gate, so n_override_ticks == 0 is forced by construction; per the two-dispositions rule it is scoped OUT of criterion scoring (disposition (b)) and its zero is recorded as a diagnostic rather than dressed up as a criterion it passes vacuously. It is retained because EVB-0610's dispatch contract requires a discriminative pair on >=2 matched shared seeds, and because it is the control making the ON arm's override count attributable to the gate rather than to the instrument. Readiness preconditions are ON-arm only for the same reason. GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout = resolved decisions per GENUINE override tick. Checked v3_exq_910_..._20260810T004433Z_v3.json and v3_exq_910a_..._20260810T213616Z_v3.json -- both record only the latched per-env-step counter (the defect), neither retained a per-step episode log, and both predate the 2026-08-20 substrate amend. Not recoverable by reanalysis; a run is required. RE-DERIVE BRAKE (2.5b): MECH-489 run-keyed brake count = 0 (both prior autopsies read a code-bug/instrument confound, not a substrate ceiling). Brake does not fire. SUBSTRATE-PATH OVERLAP GATE (2.5c) -- recorded, not silently passed. Degrading and on-path: SD-ORIENTING-DECISION-SCALE (agent.py::select_action) -- this run IS its validation; SD-E3-SCORER-COMPLETION (e3_selector.py) -- arm-invariant. Corrupting entries whose substrate_paths name a file this driver imports, none on this run's DV path and all arm-invariant in a single-variable ablation: mode-governance-engagement (whole-file agent.py; its own severity_note scopes the live successor defect to the _lib/regime_occupancy_gate.py gate pattern, which this driver does not use); MECH122-CONTENT-PACKAGING-SPINDLE-SELECTION (agent.py::run_sws_schema_pass, mel_consumer.py::relative_novelty; its severity_note scopes the risk to experiments consuming relative_novelty -- no criterion here reads any sleep/SWS/novelty quantity); contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy (e1_deep.py; read by no criterion). Not treated as blocking because a whole-file agent.py listing would blanket-block every experiment -- 47 have been queued since 2026-08-10 on that same path -- so the module-level match is read as a screening flag and the disposition turns on whether the defect is on this run's DV path. Flagged here for any later autopsy. PROGRESS-INSTRUMENTATION FIX inherited from 910a: the reused 906b run_seed already emits one 'verdict:' line per cell, and 910a added a SECOND, so its 4 cells printed 8 verdict lines against a declared seeds=2 x conditions=2 = 4, driving the runner's overall_pct() past 100%. This driver prints no verdict line of its own -- confirmed 2 lines for the 1-seed x 2-arm dry-run, so 6 at full scale = declared seeds(3) x conditions(2). SMOKE: validate_experiments.py --strict --paths OK, exit 0, ZERO warnings of any kind (ANCHOR_REACHABILITY_EXEMPT added with the reachability argument stated per-anchor). Three --dry-run passes, all rc=0. The dry-run is itself the first direct measurement of the defect: ON arm 60 eval steps -> n_override_ticks=1 with decision_counts sum=1 (C1 identity holds exactly) while the legacy readout on the SAME steps reported decision_counts_latched_sum=9, i.e. realized_inflation_ratio_decisions=9.0, and n_triggers_latched=9 against n_trigger_ticks=2. Fresh-tick fraction 0.18 (fresh=11, latched=49). OFF-arm control recorded 0 fresh ticks and 0 overrides as designed. z_goal_stream active_frac=0.998, no writer defect. Correctly self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue at toy scale (preconditions unmet at 60 eval steps), the same expected pattern as 910/910a's own dry-runs. Note the single resolved decision was 'approach' -- the first non-withdraw decision anywhere in this lineage; n=1, so a wiring demonstration only, NOT evidence. ON COMPLETION (for the reviewing session, not done by this queue-time entry): update the SD-ORIENTING-DECISION-SCALE second failure_record in REE_assembly/evidence/planning/substrate_queue.json from 'substrate_half_resolved_2026-08-20 ...; driver half OWED' to a full 'resolved' ONLY once this run has actually produced a bounded counter, and release EVB-0610 / EXP-0035 from blocked_substrate per /implement-substrate Step 8(d).
